definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to a noun to mean the charge or payment for that service or thing. Especially common for transport fares, rent, and labor wages.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}{賃|ちん}が{値上|ねあ}がりした。
{手間|てま}{賃|ちん}は{作業|さぎょう}の{内容|ないよう}によって{変|か}わる。
examples.english: The labor charge varies depending on the type of work.

notes:
Suffix forming nouns for fares, rent, and wage-like charges. Tends to attach to native or fixed Sino-Japanese bases ({家|や}{賃|ちん} rent, {運|うん}{賃|ちん} fare). Less productive than 〜{代|だい} or 〜{料|りょう}.

COMPOUNDS:
- {家|や}{賃|ちん}: rent
- {運|うん}{賃|ちん}: fare; freight charge
- {電車|でんしゃ}{賃|ちん}: train fare
- {手間|てま}{賃|ちん}: labor charge; piece-work pay
- {船|せん}{賃|ちん}: ship fare; passage
- {駄|だ}{賃|ちん}: pocket money; small reward

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{代|だい}: bill; fee — broader; everyday utility bills and item charges
- 〜{料|りょう}: fee — formal institutional fees ({授業|じゅぎょう}{料|りょう} tuition)
- 〜{費|ひ}: expenses — a category of spending ({生活|せいかつ}{費|ひ} living expenses)
